subject: RACER recovery after an exact generated-BPE reconciliation (engine-only fix)

checked_here: server/steps.jsonl: turn-0/step-0..3 ok; turn-0/step-4 draft completed, then the c1v2 regeneration (recovery_append source_message_indices [1, 2], native_evidence_tokens 158) returned HTTP 400 PERSISTENT_HISTORY_RECOVERY_GENERATION_PREFIX_UNAVAILABLE
the committed step-3 action is raw generated text ending in ']}\n</function>\n<tool_call>...</tool_call>'
server/sglang_http.jsonl: one request carries persistent_session_retokenization_reconciled true with persistent_session_retokenization_token_shift 1

cause.summary: CommitKV/AgentKV keep earlier generated actions in their generated token IDs (serving_chat._reconcile_exact_generated_prefix). After a reconciled continuation the canonical prompt no longer starts with the freshly rendered chat body, so _convert_to_internal_request recorded an empty generation prompt and the next recovery_append failed its generation-prefix check
cause.second_blocker: with the prompt found, the freshly rendered recovery body still differs from the generation base in the same BPE, so the PERSISTENT_HISTORY_RECOVERY_BODY_PREFIX_MISMATCH check would have failed next
cause.session_state: both checks run in serving_chat before scheduler admission; the rejected request left the held draft intact, but the paper runner treated the 400 as a terminal failure

change.serving_chat._persistent_generation_pref: the generation prompt is the freshly rendered suffix after the freshly rendered body and must end canonical_prompt_ids; identical to the old result whenever no reconciliation happened
change.serving_chat._prepare_persistent_history: for an exact-output session, a recovery whose freshly rendered body differs from the generation base is moved into the generated-token frame with _reconcile_exact_generated_prefix (hint coordinates remapped before replacement/evidence spans are derived); changed text and non-exact sessions still raise RECOVERY_BODY_PREFIX_MISMATCH
